mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_id, product_id, order_id, score, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{orderId}, #{score}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.product_id, r.order_id, r.score, r.content, r.create_time, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS nickname FROM review r JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
